name: g4.Peek
title: Peek UIA Tree At Coordinates
description: Resolves the UI Automation element from supplied coordinates, focus, or the current cursor position, and returns its ancestor chain.

x.description: The X screen coordinate in pixels. Any supplied coordinate takes precedence over focused.

y.description: The Y screen coordinate in pixels.

focused.description: If true and both coordinates are missing, peek the currently focused UI element.
